instruction.text: Wähle die richtigen verbindenden Adverbien für die Lücken aus.

atoms.b: ((++At_first In_the_end)) he searched in the fridge. ((++That's_why)) he couldn't find the potatoes. He found them in the cabinet eventually.
((++All_in_all)) we had a great holiday. The weather wasn't always good, ((++so)) we didn't go to the beach very often. ((++However)), we enjoyed every day.
Now I know why our car must be charged, but ((++at_first)) I couldn't understand. ((++That's_why)) I always ask my parents when I don't know something.
((++At_first)) Colleen didn't know how to solve the task, ((++so)) she asked the teacher for help. ((++In_the_end)) she was able to solve all the tasks in the test.

((++At_first Then Because)) we were at a Chinese restaurant ((++since but after)) Lucinda loves spring rolls and I like Kung-Pao-sauce.
We went to the cinema ((++as_soon_as while that)) we finished our meals ((++because if so)) we were already a little late for the film.
